about: The base bake's tile spec (basemap/landscape/README.md). plan.py and bake.py read this file and test_plan.py checks it; the numbers here are the contract. A change here changes every bake's name.
zoom_about: Vector tiles (MVT in PMTiles, gzip) from z8 to z16 (plan §3.5): z16 tiles are about 440 m across here, at 4096 units a tile about 0.11 m each, and the app overzooms them for curbs, crosswalks and stalls (z16.5-17.5). A layer's minzoom and maxzoom in its export manifest narrow its range; a minzoom past z16 is baked at z16 and left to the style.

writer.about: GDAL's PMTiles (MVT) writer: EXTENT, BUFFER, SIMPLIFICATION (in tile units, below z16) and SIMPLIFICATION_MAX_ZOOM (none at z16, so real-width surfaces keep their shape). MAX_SIZE and MAX_FEATURES are set far above anything a tile should hold, because past them GDAL quietly coarsens or drops features: the bake measures tiles itself instead (the budget, and the largest tile per zoom in its report).

budget.about: Every z16 tile touching the downtown box (basemap/ground/spec.json's 'downtown', 2 x 2 km, 30 tiles) is at most 60 KB as stored and sent (gzip; 10^3 bytes, as perf.mjs counts). Downtown is where roads' surfaces and markings are densest, so the budget binds once roads exports its base layers; every bake checks it, and an over-budget bake isn't switched in.
